title: TB vLLM
description: vLLM serving at a glance: load, throughput, latency and cache per server and model. The node agent finds a local vLLM server and scrapes its metrics endpoint; an agent installed before discovery existed needs OTEL_SCRAPE_TARGETS or a re-run.

panels.title: Servers reporting
panels.description: vLLM engines whose metrics endpoint is scraped

panels.title: Requests waiting
panels.description: Requests queued because the engine is at capacity

panels.title: First token, p95
panels.description: Time to the first token, 95th percentile over five minutes

panels.title: KV cache in use
panels.description: Fullest KV cache; a full cache makes requests wait or be preempted

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Requests that ended with an error in the time range

panels.title: Last values per server and model
panels.description: One row per node and served model. The node name links to the node dashboards.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Finished requests per second; failed or aborted ones are those ending with error or abort

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache

panels.title: Where the time goes
panels.description: Average seconds per request spent waiting in the queue, processing the prompt and generating

panels.title: Preemptions
panels.description: Requests pushed back because the KV cache ran out
